claim: The local dataset preserves the three benchmark families used to motivate MACE-MP-0 generality.
The water benchmark specification corresponds to a short 1.0 ps NVT-style simulation of 32 molecules at 330 K in a 12 Å cubic box.
The adsorption benchmark spans six fcc transition metals: Ni, Cu, Rh, Pd, Ir, and Pt.
The provided CRBH20 subset contains three DFT reference barriers between 1.72 and 1.77 eV.
Exact ab initio-level reproduction of MACE-MP-0 predictions was not possible locally because model weights were not shipped in the workspace.
